fixture.layout: { exports: { <id>: <export> } }; each export is the complete { format, responses } object a collection returned, unedited; JSON whitespace is the serializer's (one-space indent)

producer.revision_label: pre-fix inventory producer: the revision immediately before the wallet-history producer fence (U1); its helper adds an unconditional logical-account hint to every key ending in :<64 hex>, and its KV export has no audit shape field
producer.loading: the complete console module tree of that revision, extracted on its own and imported from there; no module was shared with or reloaded from the current tree
producer.module_tree_rule: sha256 over the sorted lines <path>\0<sha256>\n of every .js and .mjs file under web/strategy-switch-console of that revision, excluding node_modules and frontend

generation: the suite harness of tests/account_identity_inventory_validation.mjs (trap storage, synthetic SQLite per object, fake KV, admin session from the synthetic session secret) imported the producer tree above
each construction ran once through the real Worker route and RuntimeInstances handlers: schema, every SQL page, DO-KV pages and finalize for both objects, two complete KV passes, then the env section
zero storage or network traps fired and both databases were byte-identical after collection
each returned export was serialized without assembly or edits, and the bundle was written once

synthetic_seeds.binding: the 64-character lowercase hex binding is the pattern a3 repeated 32 times

k3.literal-observation: account_facts_observation row: platform ibkr, account_key lit-k3-obs:<binding>, payload {}
k3.literal-detail: binance_detail_daily row: account_key lit-k3-det:<binding>, binding_id <binding>, first synthetic day, payload {}
k3.wallet-daily: account_facts_daily row: platform binance, account_key bn-k3:<binding>, source_binding_id <binding> (a matching stored binding), first synthetic day, payload {}

audit.entry: { action, platform: ibkr, key } with action save_account_settings or approve_account_settings_profile_application and key the letter A repeated 512 (short) or 513 (long) times
audit.unrecognized-action: audit_log value [{ action: update_strategy_selection, platform: ibkr, key: audit-a8-key }]

synthetic_seeds.other: no other KV value and no env binding; unseeded SQL columns hold the suite defaults (seed, {})

tokens: every scan and cursor token is an AES-GCM seal under the suite's synthetic session secret and opens to scan or page metadata; the suite checks this offline
